_about: Independent synthetic retrieval evaluation labels, written without reference to any ranker. All companies are invented. Each company belongs to one TRUE business in a hand-written sector > industry > business taxonomy; the record's own sector/industry/sub_industry fields may be deliberately wrong (tag 'mislabelled'). Graded labels are derived mechanically from the true taxonomy: 3 same business, 2 same industry but different business, 1 same sector but different industry, 0 different sector. Aliases are duplicate listings of an existing company (different ticker, reworded or re-cased description); they are not targets and have no label rows. Tags: paraphrase, boilerplate, geo_trap, jargon, mislabelled are hand-assigned (boilerplate and geo_trap follow the shared text); cross_country is computed (none of its same-business peers is in its own country). Splits alternate dev/held_out inside every business.
